## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow leadership concentrated in Energy (Top 5: 4/5 Energy) while large-cap Tech and Financials are mostly BELOW TREND, producing mixed signals that justify a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities show modest positive returns (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) supporting limited defensive support.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging with major names AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lag: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare also soft with LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +11.12%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND; PSA (1W: -5.54% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND; EL (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND; AVGO (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across select Tech and cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: TSLA (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY — three large names with 1W/1M mismatch suggests tactical opportunities and watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak: AAPL (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND while GOOGL (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +1.77%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND provide isolated support; sector 1W: -0.72% (24 stocks) indicating internal weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft overall: JPM (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -1.79%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -2.27%) BELOW TREND; financials 1W: -1.01% and not confirming a cyclical leadership shift.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure with LLY (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND, though UNH (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%) shows RECOVERY signals; sector 1W: -1.77% suggests continued caution.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor tactical exposure to Energy names showing clear ABOVE TREND momentum (VLO, OXY, XOM) and monitor RECOVERY setups in Health (UNH, PFE) for follow-through; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech that remain BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Given narrow leadership and three-stock divergence, remain selective and wait for confirmation before adding new core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND for continuation. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND for downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +10.17%) — leadership and momentum. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.08%) and Industrials (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.32%) — watch for widening weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch OXY/XOM sustaining weekly gains (continued >+6% 1W) to confirm Energy extension; NVDA reclaiming positive 1M momentum would be needed to shift from BELOW TREND toward RECOVERY; ADBE further weekly losses below current 1W pace would deepen its BELOW TREND risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+60): NVDA (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND — bullish CEO commentary is positive but price is falling (distribution), monitor for accumulation. EMR (+70): EMR (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND — raised guidance and buyback but price is falling, a divergence to watch for reversal.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-60): ADBE (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and CEO exit confirming price weakness. MSFT (-45): MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND — legal/partnership headlines align with downward pressure. META (-45): META (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming the sell-off.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style given narrow Energy leadership. OXY (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences (TSLA, UNH, PFE RECOVERY) and Tech names with negative sentiment (ADBE, MSFT, META) — watch for trend confirmation.
